commit 5f39e88a88f39f7e508dc1fede30a2e0bb486008
Author: Martijn van Beurden <mvanb1@gmail.com>
Date:   Fri Feb 17 07:30:13 2023 +0100

    Fix strlen being used on uninitialized data

diff --git a/src/metaflac/utils.c b/src/metaflac/utils.c
index e3f27601..236fde4e 100644
--- a/src/metaflac/utils.c
+++ b/src/metaflac/utils.c
@@ -76,6 +76,11 @@ void local_strcat(char **dest, const char *source)
        *dest = safe_realloc_add_3op_(*dest, ndest, /*+*/nsource, /*+*/1);
        if(*dest == NULL)
                die("out of memory growing string");
+       /* If ndest == 0, strlen in safe_strncat reads
+        * uninitialized data. To prevent that, set first character
+        * to zero */
+       if(ndest == 0)
+               *dest[0] = 0;
        safe_strncat(*dest, source, outlen);
 }
